about_pullquote: We got into this because we were tired of electricians leaving half a job done and overcharging neighbours.
about_para_1: North Ace Electrics has been the go-to electrician for Newcastle homeowners and businesses for nearly two decades. We started small — one van, one tradesman — and grew by word of mouth because we turn up on time, finish what we start, and never rush a job. Today we're a five-strong team covering the city and surrounding areas with the same commitment to quality that built our reputation.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our no-nonsense approach: transparent pricing, no hidden charges, and a willingness to talk you through the options before we touch a wire. We're NICEIC registered, fully insured, and proud that most of our work comes from repeat customers and their neighbours. Your safety and peace of mind are what we're paid to deliver.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About North Ace

reviews.text: Had a complete rewire done last spring. Lads were tidy, punctual, and really explained what was happening at each stage. New consumer unit makes a massive difference — no more tripped circuits when the kettle's on. Would definitely book again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Emergency call at 11pm on a Saturday. Someone came out within the hour, traced the fault, and had us back up and running by midnight. Fair price for the callout too. Can't ask for better service than that.
reviews.author: Lisa H.

reviews.text: Fitted our EV charger last month. Whole job was seamless — they even popped back to check everything was working properly after a week. Friendly lads, good work, honest quote. Highly recommend to anyone in Newcastle.
reviews.author: David R.
